title: memtomem-stm: Concurrent LTM recovery can duplicate reconnects or reuse a cancelled transport session (CVE-2026-77331)
description: CVE-2026-77331 is a concurrency vulnerability in memtomem-stm affecting versions from 0.1.2 up to but not including 0.1.34. It involves concurrent surfacing RPC failures that can cause duplicate reconnect attempts for the same session and allow reuse of a cancelled transport session due to interrupted protocol exchanges. The issue was introduced in version 0.1.24 and affects a broader range of versions due to cancellation recovery problems. A fix is available in version 0.1.34.
